function: PPO controller sets RIS phase shifts to jointly maximize received SNR and Bell-state entanglement fidelity while limiting decoherence and RIS control overhead (p. 4).
system: Single-antenna transmitter and receiver, 8-element passive phase-only reflecting RIS with direct link; THz carrier, 0.1 and 0.5 THz studied (p. 4, 12, 15).
method: PPO actor-critic reinforcement learning (Stable-Baselines, 8000 timesteps); meta-learning initialization and federated PPO with FedAvg across RIS sites as extensions (p. 10-12).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rayleigh CN(0,1) fading, THz pathloss with molecular absorption and log-normal shadowing, phase-flip decoherence model; no external dataset (p. 4, 12).
test_conditions: Same simulated distribution for training and testing; 15 PPO and 15 random episodes; meta-learning adapts to unseen environments in about 20 steps (p. 12, 16).
baselines: No-RIS, Random RIS, SNR-only RIS, Quantum-flat RIS, and model-based MO-PG projected gradient; no learned baseline (p. 12, 13).
metrics: Received SNR, entanglement fidelity, decoherence probability, hybrid reward, runtime, reliability score (Tables 3 and 4, p. 11; Fig. 7, p. 17).
complexity: Table 5 orders: PPO inference O(N), MO-PG O(KN^2); measured PPO inference below 5 ms versus MO-PG above 1500 ms at N=256 (p. 12, 17).
q1_support: p. 12: "No external dataset is used during training." The channel is a custom simulator (Rayleigh fading, p. 4, plus a THz pathloss formula); no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 16: "adaptation under unseen THz environments using meta-initialized PPO"; p. 16: "near-stable performance is reached within approximately 20 adaptation steps".
q3_support: p. 12: "compared against Random RIS, SNR-only optimization, and model-based baseline controllers"; all are non-learned (Table 6, Learning: No), so no earlier learned method or standard RL algorithm is compared. Local-only versus FedAvg and cold-start versus meta-initialization are variants of the proposed method.
q4_support: p. 17: "The PPO inference runtime remains nearly constant and below 5 ms as the RIS dimension increases from 32 to 256 elements." Table 5 (p. 12) also gives O(N) for PPO inference and O(KN^2) for MO-PG.
q5_support: p. 12: "generated entirely from the analytical channel and decoherence models"; the paper gives no link to code or data and uses no public dataset or measured data.
notes: Included, area 3: the learned PPO controller sets RIS phase shifts; the reward also contains Bell-state fidelity from a phase-flip model, which does not change the function. Single antenna at both ends but with a RIS, so the single-antenna exclusion does not apply (p. 4). q2 rests on the supplementary meta-learning study (Fig. 6a, p. 16), whose unseen environments are not described in detail, so the reviewer should confirm it. The main PPO results use a single simulated distribution. Tables 1 and 3 to 6 are images and were read from the PDF pages.
